desc: Real, crispy Chex cereal pieces covered in a chocolatey peanut butter coating with a delightful powdery smooth finish. Individually packaged in a 4.5 oz format, a great sweet treat for the grab-and-go convenience store patron, with 50% less fat than potato chips.
features:
• Real, crispy Chex cereal pieces covered in a chocolatey peanut butter coating with a delightful powdery smooth finish.

  • 7 packaged bags in a 4.5 oz format for ease of placement in convenience store salty sets.

  • This unique combination of sweet and salty helps bring something for everyone to love to convenience store salty sets.

  • Muddy Buddies have 50% less fat than Potato Chips and make for a great sweet and salty alternative.
ingredients: Chex cereal coated in a combination of peanut butter and chocolate (peanut butter, cocoa, sugar, milk solids, natural flavors) along with a dusting of powdered sugar; Contains wheat, milk, peanuts, and soy ingredients.
